text: A number of residents on Glengowan Road have contacted me to share their concerns about speeding cars on their street. Representatives from the neighbourhood submitted a petition signed by 44 residents requesting that the speed limit be lowered to 30km/h on Glengowan Road between the west end of the street and Strathgowan Crescent. Residents have observed westbound traffic cutting through Glengowan Road from Blythwood Road via Strathgowan Crescent to avoid congestion at the Mt. Pleasant Road and Blythwood Road intersection. These driver are often travelling at high speeds in an attempt to make-up time after re-routing from Blythwood Road. Glengowan is a residential street with many families walking to and from the nearby parks and schools. Two public schools are located on Strathgowan Crescent, the street used to access Glengowan Road from Blythwood Road.
North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit on Glengowan Road, between the west end of the street and Strathgowan Crescent, from 40km/h to 30km/h.
